QF.id: AIF Valuation Taxation and Good Practices_44

answer.text: Completing investor KYC and KRA registration, keeping KYC and financial/income information updated, including KYC forms in the distribution kit, and cooperating with AML/CFT document requirements

explanation.text: The Logic: Per NISM XIX-A (pp. 204, 207, 270, 278), distributors complete investor KYC and KRA registration, keep financial/income status accurate and updated, include KYC documentation in the distribution kit, and provide KYC documents to tax or enforcement agencies as required under AML/CFT obligations. The Trap: KYC is not a name-check or a photo exercise, and it cannot be waived for HNIs. The same documentation and update obligations apply across investor categories. Note: Treat KYC as an ongoing duty — periodic refresh of investor income and financial information is part of the distributor's compliance workflow.
